Each concept page follows the same template (`concepts/_template.qmd`): core question,
definitions across fields, formal statement, examples, connections and distinctions, key
references, open questions, and contributors.

To propose a new concept, open a
["Propose a term" issue](https://github.com/lens-program/knowledge-base/issues/new?template=propose-term.yml),
or copy the template and open a pull request.
